name: Boots of Speed
summary: Boots that double your Speed and hamper Opportunity Attacks against you for a short time.

stats.effect:
While you wear these boots, you can take a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} to click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots double your {ref:glossary/speed}, and any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.

When you've used the boots' property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
